description:
Make `jit-server` detect the layout of the checkout holding `--data-dir` once at startup and hand that value to its storage and executor, so it stops classifying the process working directory and its handles stop detecting again.

## Background

- Server startup calls `WorktreePaths::detect()` (`crates/server/src/main.rs:67`), which detects from the process working directory (`crates/jit/src/storage/worktree_paths.rs:28-30`), keeps only its worktree root, and builds the repository layout from it (`crates/server/src/main.rs:70`). Storage comes from `prepare_server_storage` (`crates/server/src/lib.rs:65-81`) and the executor from `CommandExecutor::new(storage).with_layout(..)` (`crates/server/src/main.rs:76`); neither receives the detected paths.
- Each handle then detects again on first use through its lazy fallback: `JsonFileStorage::configured_worktree_paths` (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:556-575`) and `CommandExecutor::require_worktree_paths` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2240-2256`). A server can therefore run three detections, the first against the wrong directory when it is started outside its repository.
- The CLI already detects once from the selected data root (`crates/jit/src/main.rs:1903`) and passes the value to storage (`crates/jit/src/main.rs:1926`) and the executor (`crates/jit/src/main.rs:1968`).
- `detect()` has no other production caller.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A server-library function derives the startup layout once through `WorktreePaths::detect_for_data_root`, with the `--data-dir` directory as the selected root and the process directory as the non-git fallback root. Startup configures its storage handle and executor with that value.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test starts the derivation from a directory outside the repository with the data directory inside a git checkout and asserts that the worktree root is that checkout's root and that the paths classify it as a git checkout. Against today's derivation, which detects the process directory, both assertions fail.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: a server started outside its repository classifies the checkout holding its data directory, not the directory it was started from.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Server detects its layout once from the selected data root
